content.title: How to watch Angels vs. Cubs: TV channel and streaming options for March 30
content.text: The Chicago Cubs square off against the Los Angeles Angels after Alex Bregman hit a pair of home runs in a 6-3 defeat to the Nationals. The game begins at 7:40 p.m. ET on Monday. Edward Cabrera (0-0, 0.00 ERA) gets the start for the Cubs, who are 1-2 this season and fourth in the NL Central. Ryan Johnson (0-0, 0.00 ERA) is expected to start for the Angels, who are 2-2 and third in the AL West.How to watch Los Angeles Angels vs. Chicago Cubs Venue: Wrigley Field Time: 7:40 p.m. ET TV: MARQ and FDSW Watching in person?
